question: Where has the complete teaching about this first instant been previously explained?
premises: The term tuṭi has been defined.
All of this teaching is referenced.
The teaching is stated in the Pratyabhijñā.
inference: All this concerning the instant has been explained in the Pratyabhijñā.
plain_english: This is called the instant, and all of this has been explained in the Pratyabhijñā.
